name: Nuvemshop
description: Connect your Nuvemshop / Tiendanube store so the agent can look up products, orders and customers, cancel orders, and track refund status.

nuvemshop_get_store.label: Get Store Info
nuvemshop_get_store.description: Get basic store information such as name, domain, language and currency.

nuvemshop_search_products.label: Search Products
nuvemshop_search_products.description: Search products by name, description or SKU, optionally within a category.

nuvemshop_get_product.label: Get Product
nuvemshop_get_product.description: Get a product's details, variants, prices, stock and images by ID.

nuvemshop_get_product_by_sku.label: Get Product by SKU
nuvemshop_get_product_by_sku.description: Find the product that has a variant with the given SKU.

nuvemshop_get_order.label: Get Order
nuvemshop_get_order.description: Get an order's items, totals, payment and shipping status, and support eligibility.

nuvemshop_get_order_by_number.label: Get Order by Number
nuvemshop_get_order_by_number.description: Look up an order by the number the customer sees (e.g. #101).

nuvemshop_list_customer_orders.label: List Customer Orders
nuvemshop_list_customer_orders.description: List a customer's orders, most recent first.

nuvemshop_check_refund_status.label: Check Refund Status
nuvemshop_check_refund_status.description: Check an order's refund state, payment provider, and how a refund can be executed.

nuvemshop_cancel_order.label: Cancel Order
nuvemshop_cancel_order.description: Cancel an order with optional restock and customer notification. Does not move money.

nuvemshop_add_order_note.label: Add Order Note
nuvemshop_add_order_note.description: Add a merchant-facing note to an order as an audit trail of support actions.

nuvemshop_find_customer.label: Find Customer
nuvemshop_find_customer.description: Find customers by email or by name/document text.

nuvemshop_get_customer.label: Get Customer
nuvemshop_get_customer.description: Get a customer's full details, addresses and purchase totals by ID.

storeId.label: Store ID
storeId.description: Your numeric store ID (the user_id of your store, shown when creating the custom app).

accessToken.label: Access token
accessToken.description: Access token from a custom app created in your store admin. Grant products, orders and customers permissions.
